item.title: Obituary - Donald Leland "Don" Wheeler
item.description: Donald Leland "Don" Wheeler, 73 of Drexel, Missouri passed away Wednesday, January 14, 2026. Funeral services are pending at this time and will be published when available. Services under the direction of Mullinax Funeral Home, Drexel (816-657-4400). Messages of condolence may be left for the family at www.mullinaxfuneralhome.com.

item.title: Obituary - Robert Michael “Mike” McCarter
item.description: Robert Michael “Mike” McCarter, 71, of Nevada, MO, passed away peacefully in his sleep on Monday, January 19, 2026.Mike was born on January 31, 1954, in Nevada, MO to Robert A. and Marlene Lou (Palmer) McCarter. He grew up in Nevada, graduating from Nevada High School in 1972. Shortly after graduation, Mike met the love of his life, Vickie Diane (Wolf), and they were united in marriage on November 23, 1974, at First Christian Church in Nevada, MO. item.title: Overnight fire heavily damages Butler home
item.description: The Butler Fire Department and first responders were called to 507 S. Mechanic street overnight for a residential structure fire that fortunately resulted in no injuries to the occupants.Red Cross has been summoned to help the family; the exact cause remains under investigation.
